custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part C.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding part A with a part fee, fee 1, and part C with a part fee, fee 2.
  • Set part A inactive after canned job A is saved.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425732-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Save.
  2. Make part C: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 PART C; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425732-C; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Save.
  3. Make a work order to build the canned job on: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 LINE C in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  4. Put the parts on that line: Add parts A and C, one of each: in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type the part number in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty * and click Save.
  5. Give each part a fee: Give part A fee 1 and part C fee 2 from each part row's menu.
  6. Save the line as canned job A: Click the three-dot icon on the line, then Save as canned line. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 CANNED JOB A in Line Title. Click Save As Canned Line.
  7. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425732-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
  8. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. The New Line window opens: close it with the X at its top right, so the work order has no lines.
